text_block_list.text:
One evening, while walking through the 
shopping district with Grass Wonder—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"It's quite lively over there. Did 
something happen?"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I see, so it's the lottery raffle~

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it... Did you know, 
Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I hear lotteries originally began as 
entertainment devised by the nobility in 
ancient times.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Apparently, people would draw paper 
strips with writing on them and receive 
prizes such as cloth and thread."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you sure know your stuff, missy! Care 
to give it a try if you've got time?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. We just so happen to have lottery 
tickets, too...♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, would it be alright if I gave it 
just one spin?
choice_data_list: We're aiming for the grand prize!
We're aiming for the grand prize!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'll do my best to meet your 
expectations.

Grass Wonder firmly holds the lever with 
both hands and turns the raffle wheel.
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Huh? R-Really?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That poses a bit of a problem, though. A 
trip sounds lovely, but I can't just leave 
right away—
choice_data_list: Is it tough to make time for it?
Is it tough to make time for it?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
“Still, once everything has settled down, 
spending some time looking back on the 
road we've walked won't be so bad.”
choice_data_list: You mean after the Twinkle Series?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Whether the path I ran with an 
unyielding spirit of "No Retreat" was 
truly satisfying or not—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I think this will be a good opportunity to 
look back on the path we've walked so far.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
So... Trainer, would you please come with 
me when that time comes?
choice_data_list:
Is it okay for me to tag along on the trip 
too?
Can I come along on the trip too?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I don't want anyone else. It has to be the 
Trainer who walked this path with me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Give me a promise, Trainer. If you do, I 
know I can try even harder.
choice_data_list: Got it, I'm looking forward to it
Got it, I'm looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much. I will continue 
pushing forward in preparation for the 
time to come.

Nodding to her as she stood with firm 
resolve, I agreed to hold onto the hot 
springs vacation ticket for her.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: My, that looks delicious~♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If we pour Japanese-style grated radish 
sauce over it, it's bound to taste 
absolutely exquisite.
choice_data_list:
Then should I buy some sauce on the way 
home?

Then should I pick up some sauce on the 
way home?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Since we're at it, I'd like to buy 
a daikon radish and make the sauce from 
scratch too.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, would you mind if we stopped by 
the greengrocer's?
choice_data_list: Yeah, sounds good.
Yeah, sure.

text_block_list.text:
Handmade sauce. It must be delicious... 
Just as I thought that, my stomach let out 
a growl.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu. It's almost dinner time, after all~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, would it be alright if I came by 
later to share some with you?
choice_data_list: ...Are you sure?
...Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ They say food always tastes better 
shared between two people rather than 
eaten alone~

Taking advantage of Grass Wonder's 
kindness, I was treated to a share of her 
special deluxe carrot hamburg steak.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"This is... certainly a portion worthy of 
being called 'heaping'~."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Would you like a few skewers as well, 
Trainer? ♪
choice_data_list: Are you sure?
Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Of course. And then there's Spe-chan, El, 
Sei-chan—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should give some to Tazuna-san 
too, as thanks for everything she always 
does~?
choice_data_list:
Are you sure it's okay to hand out that 
many?

Are you sure it's okay to hand out that 
many?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. If I had this entire amount to 
myself, I'd end up eating way too much, 
so—"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"As a reminder to myself, I thought I'd 
share some with everyone too♪"
choice_data_list: Impressive, as always.
Impressive, as always.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fierce battles will continue from here on, 
so we must keep our condition in perfect 
shape.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, don't worry. I'll make sure to 
secure my own portion♪

Admiring Grass Wonder's mindset, the two 
of us headed on our way home.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I wish we could have aimed a bit 
higher if possible.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Still, that worked out just perfectly♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I forgot to buy carrots for the salad, so 
this is a total lifesaver~.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see! Maybe that carrot was 
calling out to you, little miss!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I see. I suppose this is a kind of fate as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
This outcome might have ended up being a 
lucky strike for me too~.
choice_data_list: Lucky you, Grass.
Lucky you, huh, Grass.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ Today's salad is going to taste even 
more delicious than usual~

I headed home alongside a very 
happy-looking Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's unfortunate. I was hoping we might 
take home an award of some kind.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's really hard to win anything in a 
lottery, isn't it...?
choice_data_list:
Have you not drawn much from raffles 
before?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I had never done a lottery raffle 
before coming to Japan.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Before drawing, I thought just spinning 
the wheel would be fun enough, but—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Missing out in reality is... quite 
frustrating, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Well, don't let this discourage you; give 
it another shot if you ever get the 
chance.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes...

With Grass Wonder's shoulders slumped in 
disappointment, we began our journey back.
